==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Veronica]]. {{Chat option|1Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.}}
*Enter the manor.
*Pick up [[poison (item)|poison]] from the room south of the kitchen, on the west side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.
*Pick up the [[fish food]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, in the room south of the stairs containing the [[ghost]].
*Use the fish food on the poison to make [[poisoned fish food]].
*Search the bookcase on the western {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.
[[File:Ernest the Chicken - Oil can map.png|frame|right]]
*Climb down the ladder and complete the lever puzzle.
**Pull levers B then A down.
**Enter door 1.
**Pull lever D down.
**Enter door 1.
**Pull levers B, then A up.
**Enter doors 3, 4, and 5.
**Pull levers E, then F down.
**Enter doors 6 and 7.
**Pull lever C down.
**Enter doors 7 and 6.
**Pull lever E up.
**Enter doors 6, 8, and 3.
**Go through door 9 and grab the [[oil can]].
*Go up the ladder and pull the lever.
*Pick up the spade in the far eastern room on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.
*Exit out the back door in the same room.
*Go north around the back of the manor to the west to the compost heap.
*Search the [[compost heap]] to get a [[key (Ernest the Chicken)|key]].
*Go south and use the poisoned fish food on the [[Fountain (Draynor Manor)|fountain]] in the south-west corner of the grounds.
*Search the poisoned fountain to retrieve a [[pressure gauge]].  	
*Return to the manor and pick up the [[rubber tube]] in the room north of the stairs on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} containing an aggressive [[Skeleton (Draynor Manor)|skeleton]].
*Climb up the stairs, then climb up the spiral staircase to the west.
*Talk to [[Professor Oddenstein]]. {{Chat option|1I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.|2Change him back this instant!}}
*Talk to him again to give him the items.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
